뚜렷이.n: visible, memorable traits that stand out; often in writing
cf: Clearly in a sharp, distinct way, as with outlines, sounds, or memories.
speaking or writing neatly, one syllable at a time
Clearly and without mistake, mostly for seeing, hearing, or remembering; can add an emphatic tone.
Plainly or markedly, used when a difference or fact is obvious; more written, Sino-Korean.

적정성.n: whether a level or amount is right; reports
cf: whether something fits the situation; evaluations and audits

곧추세우다.e: to straighten; to hold something erect
곧추세우다.n: transitive: someone holds a body part or object upright
cf: intransitive: someone or something stands upright by itself
